name: BrandSync
does: Sells small businesses an affordable logo + website bundle ($500), then keeps the site alive for $30/month; also sells SEO at $2000/month, brand asset creation, and branding training.
audience: Small businesses — owner-operators and solo shops buying their first real identity; price-sensitive, not design-literate, need reassurance more than spectacle.

colors.leanings: Blue / teal family. User chose this over warm-neutral+accent. Tradeoff accepted: blue is the default agency/software trust colour and hardest to look distinctive in — mitigate by pushing teal-leaning blues, unusual blue values, and blue paired with a warm neutral, rather than generic corporate navy.

mental_image.separable_note: Standalone symbol AND standalone wordmark must each work alone, plus a combined lockup as primary. Symbol in its own <g id="mark">, wordmark in its own <g id="wordmark">.
designer_notes: 'Sync' pulls hard toward the two-circular-arrows refresh icon — the first idea everyone has, therefore everywhere. Explore in 1-2 candidates only so the user can judge it honestly.
Explicitly NOT chosen: bold & energetic. Confident, never loud.
Standalone symbol must survive the 24-32px minimum-size floor.

positioning_tension: The $500 bundle demands approachable; the $2000/month SEO retainer demands credible. Target is 'credible but warm' — professional enough to justify the retainer, friendly enough not to scare a solo shop owner. Rule of thumb, not a law.
